notes.title: A Pigeon’s Journey So Far
notes.notes:
Hey Flock!

As we get ready to launch our first public demo during Steam Next Fest, we wanted to take a moment to reflect on the amazing journey so far and the milestones that have made this dream take flight!

What started as a scribble in a 7-year-old’s sketchbook has turned into a full-blown pixel adventure and along the way, we’ve hit some incredible milestones that we want to celebrate with you. Here’s what we’ve celebrated together:

2024 • 03 • 19 Kickstarter campaign launched — Selected as a Kickstarter “Project We Love”
2024 • 09 • 18 Game Devs of Color Expo showcase Selection - honored to share our story in a space that celebrates imagination, diversity, and new voices
2024 • 11 • 12 Dev GAMM Lisbon 2024 — selected alongside incredible indie devs from around the world
2025 • 05 • 25 OTK Games Expo - Chat Choice Award Winner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858224/8fc9c2d91a214c2625f2f20182041cc5876940e9.png[/img]

Each one of these milestones reminded us that stories dreamed up by kids can resonate far and wide, and that sometimes, the smallest wings can carry you the furthest.

Now we’re gearing up for our biggest moment yet! The first-ever playable demo of Pigeon’s Mission launches June 9 as part of Steam Next Fest!

Thank you for flying with us. We can’t wait to see where this journey leads.


With love,
The Glowing Cheetah Team
(Logan & Dad)

notes.title: IT’S HAPPENING: PIGEON’S MISSION IS COMING TO NEXT FEST!
notes.notes:
Grab your feathers and mark your calendars! Pigeon’s Mission is soaring into Steam Next Fest from June 9–15, 2025! 

For the first time ever, you’ll be able to play our public demo and step into the pixel-powered, pigeon-sized shoes of Archie, a brave bird on a heartfelt journey to save his family.

Built from the imagination of a 7-year-old and his dad, this is more than a game—it’s a storybook come to life!

[h3]PLAY THE FREE DEMO[/h3]

 Explore the lush, hand-drawn world of Pepper Pines.
 Try out the Harvest Pulse System.
 Unlock power-ups like the Dust Buster, Winged Wonder, and the pilot of the powerful Tech Mech!
 Dash, jump, and glide your way through pixel-perfect platforming with precision and heart!

No sign-ups. No gatekeeping. Just hop in, explore, and see how far your wings can take you.

[h3]JOIN OUR LIVE GAMEPLAY STREAM WITH LOGAN![/h3]

We're going live to celebrate the launch of the demo, and you're invited!

 When: June 10th, Tuesday
 Time: 7:00 PM EST
 Watch live on our Steam page

Watch Logan, our 7-year-old Art Director and Co-Founder, takes you through the world born from his imagination. You’ll get behind-the-scenes stories, developer Q&A, and plenty of laughs (and probably some dramatic pinecone launches too).

Don’t forget to Wishlist Pigeon’s Mission to be notified when the demo goes live!

This is a pixel adventure powered by heart, imagination, and a little pigeon who never gives up.

See you in Pepper Pines!


The Glowing Cheetah Team 
(aka Logan & Dad)
